normal.caption_source: Posteroanterior chest radiograph ("X-ray") taken of a 21 year old woman who presented with pain on the left side of her thorax after colliding with another player during a soccer game. It shows a normal chest without any signs of injury. Dx and Sin stand for "right" and "left" respectively.
